project_overview.project_name: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer for AI SaaS Platform
project_overview.project_summary: This software / digital product project centers on Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer for AI SaaS Platform. The initial brief says: We are building a confidential AI SaaS platform and need a hands-on senior technical operator who can learn quickly, hit the ground running, and help us move faster without breaking production quality. This is not a junior role, not an agency role, and not a theory-only architecture role. The work sits mainly in Software development, Web, Mobile & Software Dev, Web Development. Stable project themes include authentication and access, administration and reporting, payments and billing, localization, analytics and reporting, outbound communication, responsive or multi-platform presentation. The available evidence includes 37 conversation messages, 13 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .md, .docx formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For engineering onboarding, the key task is to understand the product workflows, component boundaries, integrations, data responsibilities, and the evidence level behind each implementation claim before changing code. An included technical audit supplies detailed secondary evidence about repository organization, build, tests, deployment, and runtime behavior, but the underlying source tree was not directly available for inspection.
